Container.Name: shed
Container.Overview: Shed is an animal husbandry management application for tracking feedings, weights, sheds, and health records for reptiles and exotic pets.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: The host port used to access the Shed web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Container path where SQLite database, Miniflare state, and uploaded media are stored.

Config.Name: Bootstrap Token (Head Keeper Key)
Config.Description: Initial setup token used to claim the instance and log in as the administrator. Generate a 48-character hex string (e.g. via 'openssl rand -hex 24').

Config.Name: Display Token
Config.Description: Token used for public or room display views. Generate a separate 48-character hex string.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership (99 is Unraid nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership (100 is Unraid users).

Config.Name: Internal Port
Config.Description: Port the internal service binds to.

Config.Name: Allow External Paths
Config.Description: Permits volume mounts outside the app root.

Config.Name: Internal Data Path
Config.Description: Internal mount path for data storage.
